description.value: Close to Home Grocery & Deli is a neighborhood grocery and deli in Chilliwack stocking fresh produce, deli items, and household essentials alongside a menu of freshly made wraps, sandwiches, and snacks. The grab-and-go selection spans breakfast wraps with bacon, sausage, or egg-and-cheese through lunch items like chicken salad sandwiches and vegetable samosas, making it a practical mid-route meal stop. Located in a commercial unit in the Sardis/Promontory area, it serves the day-to-day needs of the surrounding neighborhood.

address.value: Unit 110-5615 Teskey Way, Chilliwack, BC V2R 0K5
